# Bannerbear

Bannerbear offers an automated image and video generation API, allowing businesses to create graphics, social media visuals, and marketing collateral with customizable templates at scale

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bannerbear/.

## Actions

- **Get Account Info** (read-only): This tool allows you to check your bannerbear account status, including quota levels and current usage.
- **Get Available Fonts** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available fonts in bannerbear.
- **Get Signed Bases** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of signed bases for a specific template.
- **Get Template Set Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific template set using its unique identifier (uid).
- **Join PDFs**: This tool allows users to merge multiple pdf files into a single pdf document by accepting an array of pdf urls, sending a post request to…
- **List Images** (read-only): Lists all images inside a bannerbear project.
- **List Templates** (read-only): This action retrieves a list of all templates available in your bannerbear project.
- **List Videos** (read-only): This action retrieves a list of all videos created in your bannerbear account.
